author: claude-fable-5-1
visual_review_findings: Compared the original (round happy face with an open book in front of its chin) with the rejected drawing (a dome sitting on a flat book, reading as a helmet) at 48px in both themes. Redrew as an r14 face whose cheek and jaw end on the nodes of an open book with a V top edge and spine, with dot eyes. Native review: reads as a face reading a book.
omissions: smile (no 8-unit room between the eyes and the book), the hand on the page; closed-eye arches become dots
construction_reference: Lucide book-open (V top edge with spine); occlusion by ending the face outline on the book's nodes
